metadata.description: free key: value pairs, passed to generators

project.description: name and documentation of the project

transports.description: custom transports offered for remote links, besides the built-in ones

basePort.description: port of the first remote link, the next ones following (default 47000)

remoteDefaults.description: defaults of the addresses of the remote links (default host 127.0.0.1)

binaries.description: executables the top-level modules are split into (each names its own); links between two of them must be remote

items.description: An executable of the project, holding some of its top-level modules

types.description: types of the project: struct, enum, exception, bitmask, union, alias, custom primitive

constants.description: named values; their names share the namespace of the types and interfaces

name.description: name of the link, unique in the project

project.description: name of a dependency: the module belongs to that other project

module.description: path of the module (in the dependency `project` when set)

from.description: initiator side (an `out` port; a container's `in` port into its content, an inner `out` port out of it)

project.description: name of a dependency: the module belongs to that other project

module.description: path of the module (in the dependency `project` when set)

to.description: receiver side (an `in` port; an inner `in` port from its container, the container's `out` port from its content)

direction.description: unidirectional: requests only; bidirectional: replies too (messages returning a value need it)

timeoutMs.description: how long to wait for the acknowledgement (ms)

class.description: realtime, low (latency), normal or bulk traffic

enabled.description: the link crosses processes or machines through a transport

transport.description: transport carrying it: ipc, shm, tcp, udp, http, websocket, grpc, mqtt, can, serial, or one of `transports`

settings.description: settings of the transport; the fields that apply depend on it

remote.description: remote link: between binaries, through a transport

constraints.description: how messages travel along the link

color.description: color (CSS color); absent: the color of its performance class

dependencies.description: other projects (project or IDL files) whose types, interfaces and modules this one uses

name.description: referenced by `uses` of other dependencies and by link endpoints (`project`)

file.description: file of the other project (project file or IDL file), relative to this one

uses.description: dependencies of this list whose types and interfaces this one uses

indirect.description: only listed because another dependency uses it

shared.description: types, interfaces and constants it defines like another dependency of this list, listed there

types.description: its own types, as last read from it

interfaces.description: its own interfaces, as last read from it

constants.description: its own constants, as last read from it

moduleTypes.description: types of its modules, as last read from it, by module path: its public ones are used by this project as Dependency/Module.Path.Name

module.description: path of the module in the dependency

modules.description: its modules placed on this canvas so that links reach them, with their attributes, methods and ports as last read (types named as in this project): top-level modules, each with all the modules inside it

module.description: path of the module in the dependency

final.description: no module may derive from it

default.description: default value: a mapping for a struct or map, a list for an array, vector, list or set, null for an empty optional, an enum value name, a list of bitmask flag names, a one-entry mapping `case: value` for a union; any value for a custom primitive

unit.description: unit of the value (numbers): m, s, Hz…

pattern.description: regular expression the whole value matches (text)

constraints.description: bounds and form of the value, of each item of a container; checked on default values

access.description: public (default): public accessors; protected: accessors for derived modules; private: no accessors

static.description: shared by all instances of the module

direction.description: in (default): caller → callee; out: callee → caller; inout: both ways

default.description: value when the caller leaves it out, as attribute defaults (in parameters only; the following parameters have one too)

returns.description: type of the returned value; null: none

access.description: public (default): called by anyone; protected: by the module and derived modules; private: by the module

virtual.description: can be overridden by derived modules

final.description: cannot be overridden by derived modules (virtual only)

threadSafe.description: may be called from several threads at once

pre.description: preconditions: expressions on its parameters and the attributes, holding when called

post.description: postconditions: expressions holding when it returns (`result`: its returned value)
